notes.title: Update - Version 1.01 Now Live
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Just a quick note to say that we updated Bitku to version 1.01 today.  Here are the changes:

- Fixed a bug that deletes objects when you press delete while editing text
- Fixed a bug that moves objects when you press the arrow keys while editing text
- Updated the objects: emoticons, humanoid bot, invader 1 & 2, wolf, heart.

And we added a new feature:
- Pressing ESCAPE while editing text will now get you out of text editing mode - it's basically a CANCEL while text editing.  Why did we not have this before... who knows!  It's there now :)

We'll announce the winners of the first contest later today.  Thanks for reading!

-Miles @ Pixeljam
